source_access: Primary NIST PDF read through the web tool; direct binary downloads returned403. No locally owned PDF or visual-verification claim yet.
interpretation: Evaluated chemical proton-transfer energies, not standard transformed biochemical-pool labels. The same proton, charge, elemental and uniform standard-state gauges cancel in each2-to-2exchange. Acid/base states remain distinct; no Alberty or empirical pKa term enters predicted raw energies.
uncertainty: NIST approximate subjective assessment, not SD/CI; parameter covariance not supplied. Sum bounds are conditional sensitivity intervals, not predictive confidence.
development_exposure: Known buffer constants and class approximations are part of historical MetaG development. This is component/model validation, not primary independent metabolic test enrollment.
